# VS Code Codicons — selected icon sources

Creator: Microsoft and contributors.
Repository: https://github.com/microsoft/vscode-codicons
Pinned revision: 6833ea2bc5fc49220e261a4a0fd1986ea02d1d0c
Retrieved: 2026-09-18 (Europe/Brussels).

The original agent.svg, book.svg, lightbulb.svg, mcp.svg, github.svg and code.svg plus copilot.svg are retained byte-for-byte under src/icons. Original LICENSE and README.md are retained beside them.

Artwork/content license: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC-BY-4.0), https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/ . See LICENSE for the full text, including its warranty disclaimer. This attribution must accompany distribution of the adapted icons. The upstream license does not grant trademark rights; these adaptations do not imply endorsement.

Tower adaptations: codicon_agent, codicon_book, codicon_lightbulb, codicon_mcp, codicon_github, codicon_code and codicon_copilot, each v01. Modifications: direct vector contour tessellation, uniform scaling to 0.60 m maximum width/height, 0.06 m extrusion, triangulation, grounding/orientation, neutral palette material and GLB packaging. Original negative spaces and disconnected features retained; no new backing or stand.

Canonical derivatives are indexed by assets/asset_catalog.json and stored under blender/environment/codicon_<name>/v01 and assets/runtime/environment/codicon_<name>_v01.glb. Source URL, creator, license URL and adaptation description are also embedded in each model's root metadata.
